decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - 1)	If you commence work on the hereby approved ground floor extension before you have completed the roof extension (00931/11/LAW1) you will invalidate the lawful development certificate for that extension.  As a result you will be liable to enforcement action which may threaten any loan secured against the property and may result in prosecution attracting a fine, if successful, not exceeding ?20000.  It is also likely to make the property difficult to sell.

Condition : 7 - 2) Building Control approval should be sought for the proposed extension, which would determine the issue of the repositioning of the existing manhole. They can be contacted on 0208583-5403.

Condition : 8 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposal, because of its design and appearance, would relate well to its site and would not harm either the appearance of the property, the surrounding area or the living conditions of neighbours. The proposed development therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension.
